segments.name: Recycled consumer electronic devices
segments.description: Sources and sells pre-owned consumer electronic devices, mainly iPhones, to wholesalers who resell them in Asia, Europe and other regions.
segments.evidence: The recycled consumer electronic devices offered by us include smartphones (various models of iPhone) and tablets (various models of iPad).

revenueModel.text: Wholesale customers pay the company for recycled consumer electronic devices, which they resell to their wholesale and retail customers.
revenueModel.evidence: Currently we derive all of our revenues from wholesale customers.

changes.text: In 2025, the Company discontinued its cold-formed-steel business and sold all ownership in the subsidiaries conducting it.
changes.evidence: In the second quarter of 2025, the Company decided to discontinue its cold-formed-steel business and sold all of the Company's ownership in the subsidiaries through which the Company conducted its cold-formed-steel business.

changes.text: In 2024, the Company acquired Lear Group Limited and Baymax High Technology Co., Limited to conduct its recycled consumer electronic devices business.
changes.evidence: We conduct our business of recycled consumer electronic devices through two Hong Kong-based wholly-owned subsidiaries Lear Group Limited and Baymax High Technology Co., Limited, acquired by the Company in October and December 2024, respectively.
